g.text: CORE INVARIANT: AI proposes. Deterministic policy decides. Infrastructure executes.
GOOGLE CLOUD MODEL ARMOR — PRE-LLM INSPECTION (SanitizeUserPrompt)
• Prompt Injection Defense ("ignore prior instructions", DAN mode, system bypass)
• Malicious Command Scanner (eval, drop table, rm -rf, bash scripts)
1. Evaluates situational context, stale duration, customer SLA status
2. Formulates structured justification and risk tier classification
3. Drafts professional tone contextual notification language
UNTRUSTED OUTPUT — NO DIRECT SIDE-EFFECT CAPABILITY
GOOGLE CLOUD MODEL ARMOR — POST-LLM INSPECTION (SanitizeModelResponse)
• Credential & API Key Leakage Filter (Google API keys, AWS tokens, JWTs)
• Cross-Site Scripting & Payload Sanitization (<script>, javascript: handlers)
• Google Cloud IAM OIDC Token Hook
Human Oversight: Approval Queue & Operator Decision
• Cross-session context preserved in Memory Bank
Resumes async workflow → dispatches to Worker
Permanently halts workflow → commits to Audit
Deterministic State Machine & Atomic State Commit
PENDING → CLAIMED → NUDGED → ESCALATED → APPROVED / DENIED
• Guaranteed Invariant: Resolved states (APPROVED / REJECTED) are permanently inert
• Scenario 13 Guard: Human direct sign-off immediately preempts background agent
• Single-source-of-truth state transitions committed via atomic Firestore transactions
Durable Async Runtime & Leased Worker Pool
• Dead letter capture after max retries
• Atomically stages side-effect events before network calls
• Prevents ghost executions and dual-write divergence across failures
Strictly gated by ALLOW / Human Sign-off
React 18 Control Plane Dashboard (Vite + Tailwind + TypeScript)
• Real-time Action Ledger & Live Proof-of-Autonomy Metrics
• Human Approval Queue with 1-Click Sign-Off / Reject buttons
• Agent Fleet Capability Inspector & Agent Registry Live Viewer
• Interactive 3-Tier Scenario Runner (Case A, Case B, Case C)
• Memory Bank Viewer with session inspection & audit history
Blocked Action Sink & Security Rejection Handler
• Denied actions (Amount > ₹25,000 or unauthorized tool request)
• Model Armor prompt/response violations or replay attacks
• Emits audit record → 0 side effects dispatched
6. STATE, MEMORY & AUDIT LEDGER (Google Cloud Firestore + OpenTelemetry)
• Cryptographic audit records of all decisions
• Full forensic causality ("Why did it act?")
CASE A (LOW RISK): Finance Agent → ₹2,000 refund proposal
Policy: < ₹5,000 → ALLOW → Leased Worker dispatches refund → Audit Ledger logged
CASE B (MEDIUM RISK): Finance Agent → ₹20,000 refund proposal
Policy: ₹5,000–₹25,000 → HUMAN APPROVAL → Pauses in Memory → Operator Approves → Executes
CASE C (HIGH RISK / DENIED): Finance Agent → ₹100,000 refund proposal
Policy: > ₹25,000 → DENY → Blocked deterministically → 0 Side effects dispatched → Logged

svg.text: ApprovalLoop Governed Architecture • Google Cloud Run + Gemini 3.7 Flash (`google-genai`) + Google Cloud Model Armor + Firestore • Invariants 100% Verified
